Individual contextual follow-up, November 17–22, 2026. At supplied PDF p.64, the quotation’s qualifier was checked against the actual CASI translation of the 2020 Science of Military Strategy, printed p.142/PDF 150, preserved by GPO. The words as appropriate are present. They express discretion or context; by themselves they do not establish the primer’s further inference that wartime plans had not been fully developed. A statement that guidance should be developed is also not proof that no such plans existed. The 2020 book and January 2022 English translation are distinct dates, and the Chinese original was not independently compared here. The quotation is supported as a quotation of this translation; the stronger institutional inference remains open. No attack method was reconstructed.
